EmailTemplate.description: SignZero recall email. Edit freely, or clone it and set the copy in SignZero Email Templates. Keep the [[...]] placeholders SignZero fills in; see the technical guide.
EmailTemplate.name: SignZero Recall
EmailTemplate.subject: Recalled: [[DocumentName]]
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello [[SignerName]],
[[CompanyName]] has recalled "[[DocumentName]]". The signing request is cancelled and any signing link you received for it no longer works.
[[RecallReason]]
No further action is needed from you.
